rules.statement: When a right to discharge surplus rain water along a defined channel has been acquired by prescription and a new channel is substituted for the old one by agreement, the benefit of possession of the old channel would attach to the new one.
rules.supporting_quote: It has been held in the case of Costa v. Livera [1 (1912) 16 N.L.R. 26 ; 2 C.A.C. 28] that when a right of way has been acquired by prescription and a new route ha been substituted by agreement for the old route the benefit of the old possession would attach to the new route.
